[\"Any guidance on getting across the re.text: # Know before you go — re:Invent 2026 - Source: https://aws.amazon.com/events/reinvent/know-before-you-go/ - Section: Know before you go - Event year: 2026 - Source type: official - Retrieved: 2026-11-04 ## Know before you go Everything you need to make the most of every day at re:Invent. ### Plan your schedule Sessions run across multiple Las Vegas properties, so check where yours are held and allow 30 to 45 minutes between venues. Favorite sessions in the event catalog or the mobile app, then reserve seats for the ones you can't miss. Seats in popular sessions are limited. ### Your travel checklist - Attendee photo. Upload it in the registration portal to save time at badge pickup. - Broken-in shoes, plus a second pair. You'll walk between venues every day. - Layers. You'll move between indoor and outdoor spaces. - Portable charger. You'll need the app for schedules, maps, and shuttle times, so keep your phone charged. - Refillable water bottle, lip balm, and lotion. Las Vegas air is very dry. - Snacks. Sessions and travel time can run past a meal. - Room for swag. Leave space for everything you collect along the way. ### Getting oriented on day one Pick up your badge on Sunday or Monday at Harry Reid International Airport in terminals T1 or T3, at the MGM Grand, or at The Venetian. Bring a government-issued ID, and wear your badge all week. You'll need it for sessions and re:Invent transportation. AWS re:Invent transportation helps you get between venues. Shuttles and the monorail are complimentary with a valid badge. The mobile app has schedules, maps, shuttle times, and an AI assistant, so download it before you arrive. Need directions between venues? Follow the on-site signage and the app. Every venue has a Content Hub, so wherever your day takes you, there's more to learn close by. Each hub runs silent breakout sessions and simulcasts, and depending on the venue, you may also find self-paced labs, talks from builders, or meetups. re:Invent is built to be welcoming. First-timers and longtime attendees learn side by side, and peers learn from each other in collaborative environments.

[\"Any guidance on getting across the re.text: # re:Invent 2026 FAQs — Registration & passes - Source: https://aws.amazon.com/events/reinvent/faqs/ - Section: Registration & Passes - Event year: 2026 - Source type: official - Retrieved: 2026-11-04 ## Registration & Passes ### How much does it cost to attend re:Invent? Full conference passes include access to keynotes, breakout sessions, hands-on labs, and the broader event experience, including re:Play: the official re:Invent party. An add-on pass is available for re:Play-only entry. Full conference: - Full price: $2,499 - Bulk purchase price: Save 10% when purchasing 10 or more passes in a single transaction. Terms and conditions apply. - re:Play guest pass: $350 ### Is there an age requirement to attend re:Invent? Yes. All attendees must be at least 18 years of age by the day they pick up their conference badge. ### How do I purchase bulk discount tickets? During registration, you'll see the option to purchase group passes. If you plan to attend the event, you'll be able to apply a pass to yourself after you complete the purchase. Once you add 10 or more tickets to your cart, the 10% discount will automatically be applied. No discount code is needed. Upon completing the purchase, your group codes will be available in the attendee portal under the pass management tab. Provide the registration code to each person attending, and they will apply the code when registering to remove the cost of the conference pass. Each person must register themselves through their own account. ### How can I purchase a re:Play guest pass? During registration, select the re:Play guest pass, or choose the option to purchase additional passes from your attendee portal after you've completed registration. The purchase will generate a registration code that you will provide to your guest, which they will use to register themselves. Your guest will need to have a badge in order to attend re:Play. If you are already registered, you will not need to purchase a re:Play pass for yourself; entry is included in your general event registration. ### Do I need to be registered to attend the conference? Yes. You need to be registered for re:Invent in order to attend any event sessions or functions. A valid conference badge and lanyard are required when in the designated event spaces. ### Are there day passes or Expo-only passes available? No.

Here's what's available, what you can request, and how to get support before and during the event. ### Services available to all attendees #### Accessible seating Accessible seating is available in keynotes and session venues for attendees who are blind or low vision, deaf or hard-of-hearing, or who use mobility devices. Accessibility icons in and near the venue will guide you to these seats. For workshops, code talks, and sessions, an ambassador will be available in the room to assist with seating. #### All-gender restrooms All-gender restrooms will be available throughout the event. #### Assistive listening devices Assistive listening devices will be available for all keynotes, breakout sessions, lightning talks, and chalk talks. #### Lactation room A private, secure space will be provided for lactating attendees to express milk. A fridge will be available in the space. #### Live captioning All keynotes, breakout sessions, and lightning talks will feature live captioning for session content. The iPads will be provided on a first-come, first-served basis. #### Reflection room A quiet space that attendees can use for meditation, prayer, yoga, or finding resources for sensory needs will be available on campus. #### Sensory notice Some areas of re:Invent, especially the Expo and keynotes, include loud noise, moving lights, and atmospheric fog. Earplugs, fidget tools, noise-cancelling headphones, strobe-reducing glasses, and visual cue and feeling thermometer cards are available at the reflection room. #### Translations for keynotes Live translations in Japanese, Korean, Mandarin, and Spanish are available for keynotes. Contact customer support (awsreinvent-support@amazon.com) to coordinate. The deadline for all requests is Nov. 13, 2026.

[\"Any guidance on getting across the re.text: This was a chance for all of the grantees to connect with each other and the alumni advisors, play games, have a couple of drinks, eat some food, and overall break the ice before heading into the first day of re:Invent. ### Day 1: Sessions, House of Kiro, and the Expo Hall My first session was scheduled for 8am at MGM Grand. Before heading to re:Invent, I was aware it's large scale across the strip and had many people sharing tips about leaving enough time to get to your next session. Good time management and discipline are definitely needed to ensure you attend all of the sessions you want to see throughout the week, but it is also important to take the conference at a pace that suits you. The expo hall opened at 4pm. The conversations, swag, and networking that can happen with companies in this hall is an experience I had only ever read or heard about. ### ABW-specific programming I experienced ABW grantees got priority access to all of the keynotes. They fill up fast, so it is great to know that as long as you show up within the time window you need to be there for — you will have a seat reserved if you are a part of the grant. I started one day with the speed mentoring and networking session that was created specifically for participants of the ABW Grant. Before another session, I hung out in the ABW Lounge to get some professional headshots. As a 2025 recipient of the grant, I received 100% off one certification of my choice and as a ticket holder for re:Invent, I have another 50% off discount that I can also use. On the final evening there was a closing reception in the Wynn for the All Builders Welcome Grant before re:Play, the official closing party for the main conference week. ### Takeaways from a first-time grantee - re:Invent is HUGE and sees around 60,000 attendees from all around the world and spans across 6 hotels on the Las Vegas strip — your step count will be insane. - Your network will grow rapidly. I met so many people through the ABW program, during sessions, and even just when travelling between venues. - You will learn a lot about yourself in an environment with many like-minded people who are willing to give advice over a session or a coffee. - Pace yourself. The tiredness hit me the most on Day 3 and it is very important to take breaks.

[\"Any guidance on getting across the re.text: # re:Invent 2026 FAQs — Hotels & accommodations - Source: https://aws.amazon.com/events/reinvent/faqs/ - Section: Hotels & Accommodations - Event year: 2026 - Source type: official - Retrieved: 2026-11-04 ## Hotels & Accommodations ### Are there discounted hotel rates for attendees? Yes. You will be able to access exclusive discounted rates at our select hotels after completing registration through your attendee portal. The discount will be automatically reflected in the rates; no code is needed. Discounted rates are available as inventory allows through November 5, 2026. ### How do I book a hotel for re:Invent? After completing registration, select Book or manage hotel, or log back in to your attendee portal to make a reservation. Hotels fill quickly, so we recommend making your reservation early. Sleeping room blocks close November 5, 2026. ### Will a deposit be charged to my credit card for the hotel reservation? Yes. You are required to provide a credit card when making a hotel reservation. A one-night deposit will be charged to your card directly by the hotel prior to the event. ### When will I receive a confirmation of my hotel reservation? After registering, you will receive a registration confirmation email followed by a separate email with your hotel acknowledgement number. Note that this is an acknowledgement, not a final hotel confirmation. You can verify your hotel booking at any time in your attendee portal. Official hotel confirmation emails will be sent directly by the hotel between November 5-13. Be sure to check your junk/spam folder if you haven't received one by then. ### How do I make changes to my reservation? You can make changes to your hotel reservation through your attendee portal by selecting Book or manage hotel until early November. To request availability at other hotels after you've made a reservation, email customer support at awsreinvent-support@amazon.com. ### What is the cancellation policy for the hotel reservation? All reservations made through the re:Invent block follow each hotel's cancellation policies. Please contact the hotel directly to inquire about their cancellation policy. ### I am under 21. Can I still stay at a re:Invent campus hotel? Due to gaming regulations, you must be at least 21 years old to make a reservation at all re:Invent campus hotels, excluding Treasure Island.

Walk the expo to meet AWS Partners relevant to your industry, then sit down one-on-one with an AWS engineer in an Ask the Experts session. [\"Can ABW grantees pick a suite instead.text: Registered attendees can start favoriting sessions in the event catalog. ### What is reserved seating? Reserved seating allows in-person attendees to secure a seat in a session in advance. Once reserved seating is open, attendees registered for in-person re:Invent can reserve seats in participating session types through the catalog by signing in to their attendee portal or by signing in to the AWS Events mobile app. ### What content types are included in reserved seating? Bootcamps, technical sessions, chalk talks, code talks, exam prep, gamified learning, select labs, and workshops all include reserved seating. Attendees do not need to reserve a seat for keynotes or lecture style-breakout sessions. If a session or activity is not included in reserved seating, it will be noted with "No reserved seating available." ### When does reserved seating open? Reserved seating is now open. Sign in to your attendee portal or the AWS Events app, navigate to the event catalog, and reserve your seats for the sessions you don't want to miss. Reserved seats are non-transferrable. ### If I reserve a seat, is my spot guaranteed? No. You must arrive at the room at least ten minutes prior to the session start time or your seat will be released to walk-up attendees and you will be asked to join the back of the walk-up line. ### What happens if I can't reserve a seat in the session I want to attend? Look for repeated instances of sessions (indicated with -R in the session ID) or continue checking back for availability in that session. You may also join the walk-up queue onsite. ### What is the difference between favoriting a session and reserving a seat? Favoriting a catalog entry adds sessions and activities you're interested in to your favorites list. You can favorite multiple sessions or activities that occur at the same time as you plan out your schedule for re:Invent. For session types that are included in reserved seating, you must take the additional step of reserving that session to secure your seat. You may not reserve seats in multiple sessions that occur at the same time. ### I favorited a session. Does that mean I have reserved a seat? No. Favoriting a session helps you better plan your time at re:Invent, but it does not reserve a seat. For session types that are included in reserved seating, you must take the additional step of reserving that session to secure your seat.

We were shuttled to Area 15, an indoor, futuristic fun zone, where we were greeted with food, music, games, and free entry into several of the Area 15 attractions. It was a fun and low-pressure way for all of us grant winners to break the ice and shake off our nerves. During the rest of re:Invent, there was a dedicated lounge for ABW grant winners. This was a quiet place where we were welcome to go to take a break from the hustle and bustle, meet with our mentors, eat delicious snacks, and share our ongoing experiences with the other grant winners. And as an added bonus, AWS offered all grant recipients the opportunity to get free professional headshots taken. On Thursday evening, AWS threw the ABW grantees a lovely closing reception.

After drinks and some fancy hors d'oeuvres, we all packed together for hilarious group photos. ### How to apply for the AWS All Builders Welcome Grant (historical, 2023) For anyone interested in applying for the ABW grant, the qualifications described at the time of this post were: - Be an underrepresented technologist in the first five years of your career - Have a strong interest in cloud computing - Be able to commit to attending all four days of re:Invent - Be at least 21 years old - Have not previously accepted a grant to an AWS event - Not be an employee, intern, independent contractor, officer, director, legal or financial advisor of AWS or any of its parents, subsidiaries, affiliates, advisors, or advertising/promotion agencies The application for the grant opens up in the summer and will be shared on the AWS re:Invent site when it opens. A lot of attendees, including many of my fellow ABW grant winners, spent quite a bit more time than I did networking and building community. This is personal experience from an All Builders Welcome Grant recipient at re:Invent 2025. It is not official AWS guidance. re:Invent 2025 was an incredible experience and could not have been possible without the AWS All Builders Welcome Grant. I was selected alongside many others globally to attend the event all expenses paid. If you are in the first 5 years of your career and meet the requirements for the application criteria — I urge you to apply for the grant in 2026 when they open next year. The opportunity to attend through the grant is once in a lifetime. ### Day 0: Arriving to Las Vegas and the ABW Grant Welcome Reception After 16 hours of travelling from Belfast, I arrived at Harry Reid airport in Las Vegas around 5pm on the 30th November, the day before re:Invent officially kicked off. AWS staff checked us in to collect our badges, which was used as a pass into re:Invent hosting hotels, sessions, and even some exclusive parties that happened in the evenings throughout the week. We got a Lyft over to Treasure Island, checked in, then headed over to the Welcome Reception for the ABW Grant via shuttle bus, which was a 7pm start at a venue within Area15. This was a chance for all of the grantees to connect with each other and the alumni advisors, play games, have a couple of drinks, eat some food, and overall break the ice before heading into the first day of re:Invent. ### Day 1: Sessions, House of Kiro, and the Expo Hall My first session was scheduled for 8am at MGM Grand. Before heading to re:Invent, I was aware it's large scale across the strip and had many people sharing tips about leaving enough time to get to your next session.

[\"Can students apply for the All Builde.text: # re:Invent 2026 FAQs — Builder ID - Source: https://aws.amazon.com/events/reinvent/faqs/ - Section: Using AWS Builder ID to register - Event year: 2026 - Source type: official - Retrieved: 2026-11-04 ## Using AWS Builder ID to register ### What is AWS Builder ID and AWS Profile? AWS Builder ID is a simple, personal identity for users, providing access to select AWS tools and services. This year, you'll be able to create or use an existing Builder ID to register for AWS re:Invent 2026. With AWS Builder ID, you can create an AWS Profile: a central place to manage your personal information and preferences. Your AWS Profile information is applied consistently across supported AWS experiences. ### Is Builder ID authentication required to register for AWS re:Invent? Yes. AWS Builder ID is required to register for re:Invent. The Builder ID serves as the authentication method for your re:Invent account. ### How do I register for re:Invent using Builder ID? Enter your email (business email preferred) or select one of the other authentication methods. If this is your first time setting up a Builder ID, you'll be prompted to create a password that you'll use to log into your re:Invent account, as well as your AWS Builder ID account. If you already have a Builder ID account, enter the credentials you normally use or select reset password. ### Who can I contact with additional questions? Please email awsreinvent-support@amazon.com for support. ### What if I already have an AWS Builder ID account? If you already have an AWS Builder ID profile, you can use those same credentials to log into your re:Invent account. ### Can I delete my Builder ID account after the event? If you no longer want to have your AWS Builder ID account, you can delete it post-event by following the instructions found in the Builder ID overview. [\"Can students apply for the All Builde.text: # re:Invent 2026 FAQs — Hotels & accommodations - Source: https://aws.amazon.com/events/reinvent/faqs/ - Section: Hotels & Accommodations - Event year: 2026 - Source type: official - Retrieved: 2026-11-04 ## Hotels & Accommodations ### Are there discounted hotel rates for attendees? Yes. You will be able to access exclusive discounted rates at our select hotels after completing registration through your attendee portal. The discount will be automatically reflected in the rates; no code is needed. Discounted rates are available as inventory allows through November 5, 2026. ### How do I book a hotel for re:Invent? After completing registration, select Book or manage hotel, or log back in to your attendee portal to make a reservation. Hotels fill quickly, so we recommend making your reservation early. Sleeping room blocks close November 5, 2026. ### Will a deposit be charged to my credit card for the hotel reservation? Yes. You are required to provide a credit card when making a hotel reservation. A one-night deposit will be charged to your card directly by the hotel prior to the event. ### When will I receive a confirmation of my hotel reservation? After registering, you will receive a registration confirmation email followed by a separate email with your hotel acknowledgement number. Note that this is an acknowledgement, not a final hotel confirmation. You can verify your hotel booking at any time in your attendee portal. Official hotel confirmation emails will be sent directly by the hotel between November 5-13. Be sure to check your junk/spam folder if you haven't received one by then. ### How do I make changes to my reservation? You can make changes to your hotel reservation through your attendee portal by selecting Book or manage hotel until early November. To request availability at other hotels after you've made a reservation, email customer support at awsreinvent-support@amazon.com. ### What is the cancellation policy for the hotel reservation? All reservations made through the re:Invent block follow each hotel's cancellation policies. Please contact the hotel directly to inquire about their cancellation policy. ### I am under 21. Can I still stay at a re:Invent campus hotel? Due to gaming regulations, you must be at least 21 years old to make a reservation at all re:Invent campus hotels, excluding Treasure Island.

[\"Can students apply for the All Builde.text: # re:Invent 2026 FAQs — On site, app, and support - Source: https://aws.amazon.com/events/reinvent/faqs/ - Section: At the Conference - Event year: 2026 - Source type: official - Retrieved: 2026-11-04 ## At the Conference ### What meals are served during re:Invent? Breakfast, lunch, and snacks will be served on full conference days. All dishes will be labeled with the following allergens/ingredients: dairy, gluten, tree nuts, shellfish, eggs, peanuts, soy, alcohol, vegetarian, and vegan. ### Will kosher and halal meals be available? Yes. Halal and kosher meals will be available while supplies last. Please contact customer support (awsreinvent-support@amazon.com) to pre-order your meals. ### How can I connect with other attendees at re:Invent? Focused meetups organized by role and interest, professional networking receptions, and community activities. Connections here tend to start around shared technical problems rather than business cards. Many attendees describe hallway conversations that became ongoing partnerships. Additional details will be added to the event catalog in the coming months. ## Mobile App ### Where can I download the AWS Events app? The AWS Events app is now available and free on the Apple App Store and Google Play. Search "AWS Events" to find it. We recommend downloading or updating before you arrive so your schedule, maps, and event information are ready on day one. ### How do I sign in to the AWS Events app this year? The AWS Events app now uses AWS Builder ID for sign-in. If you already have a Builder ID from other AWS services, you can use it to log in directly. If not, you'll be prompted to create one when you open the app. Builder ID gives you a single identity across the re:Invent app and web experience. ### What can I do in the app? The app is your planning tool before the event and your guide while you're there. Get AI-powered session recommendations based on your role and interests, build and manage your personal schedule, reserve seats, and sync everything to Outlook, Google Calendar, or your phone's native calendar. On-site, use interactive maps and turn-by-turn wayfinding to get between venues, and stay up to date on schedule changes and event updates through real-time notifications. ### Can I reserve seats for sessions in the app? Yes.

[\"Can you summarize ABW grant coverage?.text: And as an added bonus, AWS offered all grant recipients the opportunity to get free professional headshots taken. On Thursday evening, AWS threw the ABW grantees a lovely closing reception. After drinks and some fancy hors d'oeuvres, we all packed together for hilarious group photos. ### How to apply for the AWS All Builders Welcome Grant (historical, 2023) For anyone interested in applying for the ABW grant, the qualifications described at the time of this post were: - Be an underrepresented technologist in the first five years of your career - Have a strong interest in cloud computing - Be able to commit to attending all four days of re:Invent - Be at least 21 years old - Have not previously accepted a grant to an AWS event - Not be an employee, intern, independent contractor, officer, director, legal or financial advisor of AWS or any of its parents, subsidiaries, affiliates, advisors, or advertising/promotion agencies The application for the grant opens up in the summer and will be shared on the AWS re:Invent site when it opens. Coming to re:Invent, I faced a common dilemma among attendees: the choice between networking or immersing myself in the wealth of educational sessions and workshops that were available. Travel time between venues and sessions could take anywhere from 20 minutes to an hour. ### The FOMO factor AWS re:Invent is more than just a conference; it's a thriving community where connections are made, collaborations are built, and friendships flourish. A lot of attendees, including many of my fellow ABW grant winners, spent quite a bit more time than I did networking and building community. I don't regret choosing sessions, but I'll admit it's a bittersweet feeling.

Here's what's available, what you can request, and how to get support before and during the event. ### Services available to all attendees #### Accessible seating Accessible seating is available in keynotes and session venues for attendees who are blind or low vision, deaf or hard-of-hearing, or who use mobility devices. Accessibility icons in and near the venue will guide you to these seats. For workshops, code talks, and sessions, an ambassador will be available in the room to assist with seating. #### All-gender restrooms All-gender restrooms will be available throughout the event. #### Assistive listening devices Assistive listening devices will be available for all keynotes, breakout sessions, lightning talks, and chalk talks. #### Lactation room A private, secure space will be provided for lactating attendees to express milk. A fridge will be available in the space. #### Live captioning All keynotes, breakout sessions, and lightning talks will feature live captioning for session content. For other sessions, iPads are available to display AI-powered live captions at your seat. The iPads will be provided on a first-come, first-served basis. #### Reflection room A quiet space that attendees can use for meditation, prayer, yoga, or finding resources for sensory needs will be available on campus. #### Sensory notice Some areas of re:Invent, especially the Expo and keynotes, include loud noise, moving lights, and atmospheric fog. Earplugs, fidget tools, noise-cancelling headphones, strobe-reducing glasses, and visual cue and feeling thermometer cards are available at the reflection room. #### Translations for keynotes Live translations in Japanese, Korean, Mandarin, and Spanish are available for keynotes. Headsets are provided at each venue. Additional languages are available via livestream. ### Services available by request #### How to request a service The following services are only available by advance request. Contact customer support (awsreinvent-support@amazon.com) to coordinate. The deadline for all requests is Nov. 13, 2026.

This grant, which provides a complimentary trip to re:Invent, acknowledged my individual accomplishments and is also part of a bigger AWS initiative to bridge the gap in tech for people from underrepresented communities. ### My daily experience We kicked off the week on Sunday evening with a fun welcome reception. We were shuttled to Area 15, an indoor, futuristic fun zone, where we were greeted with food, music, games, and free entry into several of the Area 15 attractions. It was a fun and low-pressure way for all of us grant winners to break the ice and shake off our nerves. During the rest of re:Invent, there was a dedicated lounge for ABW grant winners. This was a quiet place where we were welcome to go to take a break from the hustle and bustle, meet with our mentors, eat delicious snacks, and share our ongoing experiences with the other grant winners. And as an added bonus, AWS offered all grant recipients the opportunity to get free professional headshots taken. On Thursday evening, AWS threw the ABW grantees a lovely closing reception.

On Thursday evening, AWS threw the ABW grantees a lovely closing reception. After drinks and some fancy hors d'oeuvres, we all packed together for hilarious group photos. ### How to apply for the AWS All Builders Welcome Grant (historical, 2023) For anyone interested in applying for the ABW grant, the qualifications described at the time of this post were: - Be an underrepresented technologist in the first five years of your career - Have a strong interest in cloud computing - Be able to commit to attending all four days of re:Invent - Be at least 21 years old - Have not previously accepted a grant to an AWS event - Not be an employee, intern, independent contractor, officer, director, legal or financial advisor of AWS or any of its parents, subsidiaries, affiliates, advisors, or advertising/promotion agencies The application for the grant opens up in the summer and will be shared on the AWS re:Invent site when it opens. So keep an eye out next June or July for it to open back up again. ### The dilemma: Network or attend breakout sessions and workshops? Coming to re:Invent, I faced a common dilemma among attendees: the choice between networking or immersing myself in the wealth of educational sessions and workshops that were available. Travel time between venues and sessions could take anywhere from 20 minutes to an hour. ### The FOMO factor AWS re:Invent is more than just a conference; it's a thriving community where connections are made, collaborations are built, and friendships flourish. A lot of attendees, including many of my fellow ABW grant winners, spent quite a bit more time than I did networking and building community. I don't regret choosing sessions, but I'll admit it's a bittersweet feeling.

[\"Do undergrads qualify for All Builder.text: # re:Invent 2026 FAQs — Builder ID - Source: https://aws.amazon.com/events/reinvent/faqs/ - Section: Using AWS Builder ID to register - Event year: 2026 - Source type: official - Retrieved: 2026-11-04 ## Using AWS Builder ID to register ### What is AWS Builder ID and AWS Profile? AWS Builder ID is a simple, personal identity for users, providing access to select AWS tools and services. This year, you'll be able to create or use an existing Builder ID to register for AWS re:Invent 2026. With AWS Builder ID, you can create an AWS Profile: a central place to manage your personal information and preferences. Your AWS Profile information is applied consistently across supported AWS experiences. ### Is Builder ID authentication required to register for AWS re:Invent? Yes. AWS Builder ID is required to register for re:Invent. The Builder ID serves as the authentication method for your re:Invent account. ### How do I register for re:Invent using Builder ID? Enter your email (business email preferred) or select one of the other authentication methods. If this is your first time setting up a Builder ID, you'll be prompted to create a password that you'll use to log into your re:Invent account, as well as your AWS Builder ID account. If you already have a Builder ID account, enter the credentials you normally use or select reset password. ### Who can I contact with additional questions? Please email awsreinvent-support@amazon.com for support. ### What if I already have an AWS Builder ID account? If you already have an AWS Builder ID profile, you can use those same credentials to log into your re:Invent account. ### Can I delete my Builder ID account after the event? If you no longer want to have your AWS Builder ID account, you can delete it post-event by following the instructions found in the Builder ID overview. Please note that if you delete your Builder ID account, you will also lose access to your current re:Invent account.

Good time management and discipline are definitely needed to ensure you attend all of the sessions you want to see throughout the week, but it is also important to take the conference at a pace that suits you. Bootcamps, technical sessions, chalk talks, code talks, exam prep, gamified learning, select labs, and workshops all include reserved seating. If a session or activity is not included in reserved seating, it will be noted with "No reserved seating available." ### When does reserved seating open? Reserved seating is now open. Once reserved seating is open, attendees registered for in-person re:Invent can reserve seats in participating session types through the catalog by signing in to their attendee portal or by signing in to the AWS Events mobile app. ### What content types are included in reserved seating? Bootcamps, technical sessions, chalk talks, code talks, exam prep, gamified learning, select labs, and workshops all include reserved seating. Attendees do not need to reserve a seat for keynotes or lecture style-breakout sessions. If a session or activity is not included in reserved seating, it will be noted with "No reserved seating available." ### When does reserved seating open? Reserved seating is now open. Sign in to your attendee portal or the AWS Events app, navigate to the event catalog, and reserve your seats for the sessions you don't want to miss. Reserved seats are non-transferrable. ### If I reserve a seat, is my spot guaranteed? No. You must arrive at the room at least ten minutes prior to the session start time or your seat will be released to walk-up attendees and you will be asked to join the back of the walk-up line. ### What happens if I can't reserve a seat in the session I want to attend? Look for repeated instances of sessions (indicated with -R in the session ID) or continue checking back for availability in that session. You may also join the walk-up queue onsite. ### What is the difference between favoriting a session and reserving a seat? Favoriting a catalog entry adds sessions and activities you're interested in to your favorites list. You can favorite multiple sessions or activities that occur at the same time as you plan out your schedule for re:Invent. For session types that are included in reserved seating, you must take the additional step of reserving that session to secure your seat. You may not reserve seats in multiple sessions that occur at the same time. ### I favorited a session. Does that mean I have reserved a seat? No. Favoriting a session helps you better plan your time at re:Invent, but it does not reserve a seat. For session types that are included in reserved seating, you must take the additional step of reserving that session to secure your seat.

This is personal experience from an All Builders Welcome Grant recipient at re:Invent 2025. It is not official AWS guidance. re:Invent 2025 was an incredible experience and could not have been possible without the AWS All Builders Welcome Grant. I was selected alongside many others globally to attend the event all expenses paid. If you are in the first 5 years of your career and meet the requirements for the application criteria — I urge you to apply for the grant in 2026 when they open next year. The opportunity to attend through the grant is once in a lifetime. ### Day 0: Arriving to Las Vegas and the ABW Grant Welcome Reception After 16 hours of travelling from Belfast, I arrived at Harry Reid airport in Las Vegas around 5pm on the 30th November, the day before re:Invent officially kicked off. AWS staff checked us in to collect our badges, which was used as a pass into re:Invent hosting hotels, sessions, and even some exclusive parties that happened in the evenings throughout the week. We got a Lyft over to Treasure Island, checked in, then headed over to the Welcome Reception for the ABW Grant via shuttle bus, which was a 7pm start at a venue within Area15. This was a chance for all of the grantees to connect with each other and the alumni advisors, play games, have a couple of drinks, eat some food, and overall break the ice before heading into the first day of re:Invent. ### Day 1: Sessions, House of Kiro, and the Expo Hall My first session was scheduled for 8am at MGM Grand. Before heading to re:Invent, I was aware it's large scale across the strip and had many people sharing tips about leaving enough time to get to your next session.

[\"May college students apply to ABW?\",.text: This was a chance for all of the grantees to connect with each other and the alumni advisors, play games, have a couple of drinks, eat some food, and overall break the ice before heading into the first day of re:Invent. ### Day 1: Sessions, House of Kiro, and the Expo Hall My first session was scheduled for 8am at MGM Grand. Before heading to re:Invent, I was aware it's large scale across the strip and had many people sharing tips about leaving enough time to get to your next session. Good time management and discipline are definitely needed to ensure you attend all of the sessions you want to see throughout the week, but it is also important to take the conference at a pace that suits you. The expo hall opened at 4pm. The conversations, swag, and networking that can happen with companies in this hall is an experience I had only ever read or heard about. ### ABW-specific programming I experienced ABW grantees got priority access to all of the keynotes. They fill up fast, so it is great to know that as long as you show up within the time window you need to be there for — you will have a seat reserved if you are a part of the grant. I started one day with the speed mentoring and networking session that was created specifically for participants of the ABW Grant. Before another session, I hung out in the ABW Lounge to get some professional headshots. As a 2025 recipient of the grant, I received 100% off one certification of my choice and as a ticket holder for re:Invent, I have another 50% off discount that I can also use. On the final evening there was a closing reception in the Wynn for the All Builders Welcome Grant before re:Play, the official closing party for the main conference week. ### Takeaways from a first-time grantee - re:Invent is HUGE and sees around 60,000 attendees from all around the world and spans across 6 hotels on the Las Vegas strip — your step count will be insane. - Your network will grow rapidly. I met so many people through the ABW program, during sessions, and even just when travelling between venues. - You will learn a lot about yourself in an environment with many like-minded people who are willing to give advice over a session or a coffee. - Pace yourself. The tiredness hit me the most on Day 3 and it is very important to take breaks.

Coming to re:Invent, I faced a common dilemma among attendees: the choice between networking or immersing myself in the wealth of educational sessions and workshops that were available. Travel time between venues and sessions could take anywhere from 20 minutes to an hour. ### The FOMO factor AWS re:Invent is more than just a conference; it's a thriving community where connections are made, collaborations are built, and friendships flourish. A lot of attendees, including many of my fellow ABW grant winners, spent quite a bit more time than I did networking and building community. [\"May college students apply to ABW?\",.text: # re:Invent 2026 FAQs — Registration & passes - Source: https://aws.amazon.com/events/reinvent/faqs/ - Section: Registration & Passes - Event year: 2026 - Source type: official - Retrieved: 2026-11-04 ## Registration & Passes ### How much does it cost to attend re:Invent? Full conference passes include access to keynotes, breakout sessions, hands-on labs, and the broader event experience, including re:Play: the official re:Invent party. An add-on pass is available for re:Play-only entry. Full conference: - Full price: $2,499 - Bulk purchase price: Save 10% when purchasing 10 or more passes in a single transaction. Terms and conditions apply. - re:Play guest pass: $350 ### Is there an age requirement to attend re:Invent? Yes. All attendees must be at least 18 years of age by the day they pick up their conference badge. ### How do I purchase bulk discount tickets? During registration, you'll see the option to purchase group passes. If you plan to attend the event, you'll be able to apply a pass to yourself after you complete the purchase. Once you add 10 or more tickets to your cart, the 10% discount will automatically be applied. No discount code is needed. Upon completing the purchase, your group codes will be available in the attendee portal under the pass management tab. Provide the registration code to each person attending, and they will apply the code when registering to remove the cost of the conference pass. Each person must register themselves through their own account. ### How can I purchase a re:Play guest pass? During registration, select the re:Play guest pass, or choose the option to purchase additional passes from your attendee portal after you've completed registration. The purchase will generate a registration code that you will provide to your guest, which they will use to register themselves. Your guest will need to have a badge in order to attend re:Play. If you are already registered, you will not need to purchase a re:Play pass for yourself; entry is included in your general event registration. ### Do I need to be registered to attend the conference? Yes. You need to be registered for re:Invent in order to attend any event sessions or functions. A valid conference badge and lanyard are required when in the designated event spaces. ### Are there day passes or Expo-only passes available? No.

[\"May college students apply to ABW?\",.text: # re:Invent 2026 FAQs — Builder ID - Source: https://aws.amazon.com/events/reinvent/faqs/ - Section: Using AWS Builder ID to register - Event year: 2026 - Source type: official - Retrieved: 2026-11-04 ## Using AWS Builder ID to register ### What is AWS Builder ID and AWS Profile? AWS Builder ID is a simple, personal identity for users, providing access to select AWS tools and services. This year, you'll be able to create or use an existing Builder ID to register for AWS re:Invent 2026. With AWS Builder ID, you can create an AWS Profile: a central place to manage your personal information and preferences. Your AWS Profile information is applied consistently across supported AWS experiences. ### Is Builder ID authentication required to register for AWS re:Invent? Yes. AWS Builder ID is required to register for re:Invent. The Builder ID serves as the authentication method for your re:Invent account. ### How do I register for re:Invent using Builder ID? Enter your email (business email preferred) or select one of the other authentication methods. Sessions and travel time can run past a meal. - Room for swag. Each hub runs silent breakout sessions and simulcasts, and depending on the venue, you may also find self-paced labs, talks from builders, or meetups. re:Invent is built to be welcoming. [\"Time to leave when walking between pr.text: This was a chance for all of the grantees to connect with each other and the alumni advisors, play games, have a couple of drinks, eat some food, and overall break the ice before heading into the first day of re:Invent. ### Day 1: Sessions, House of Kiro, and the Expo Hall My first session was scheduled for 8am at MGM Grand. Before heading to re:Invent, I was aware it's large scale across the strip and had many people sharing tips about leaving enough time to get to your next session. Good time management and discipline are definitely needed to ensure you attend all of the sessions you want to see throughout the week, but it is also important to take the conference at a pace that suits you. The expo hall opened at 4pm. The conversations, swag, and networking that can happen with companies in this hall is an experience I had only ever read or heard about. ### ABW-specific programming I experienced ABW grantees got priority access to all of the keynotes. They fill up fast, so it is great to know that as long as you show up within the time window you need to be there for — you will have a seat reserved if you are a part of the grant. I started one day with the speed mentoring and networking session that was created specifically for participants of the ABW Grant. Before another session, I hung out in the ABW Lounge to get some professional headshots. As a 2025 recipient of the grant, I received 100% off one certification of my choice and as a ticket holder for re:Invent, I have another 50% off discount that I can also use. On the final evening there was a closing reception in the Wynn for the All Builders Welcome Grant before re:Play, the official closing party for the main conference week. ### Takeaways from a first-time grantee - re:Invent is HUGE and sees around 60,000 attendees from all around the world and spans across 6 hotels on the Las Vegas strip — your step count will be insane. - Your network will grow rapidly. I met so many people through the ABW program, during sessions, and even just when travelling between venues. - You will learn a lot about yourself in an environment with many like-minded people who are willing to give advice over a session or a coffee. - Pace yourself. The tiredness hit me the most on Day 3 and it is very important to take breaks.

[\"Time to leave when walking between pr.text: Registered attendees can start favoriting sessions in the event catalog. ### What is reserved seating? Reserved seating allows in-person attendees to secure a seat in a session in advance. Once reserved seating is open, attendees registered for in-person re:Invent can reserve seats in participating session types through the catalog by signing in to their attendee portal or by signing in to the AWS Events mobile app. ### What content types are included in reserved seating? Bootcamps, technical sessions, chalk talks, code talks, exam prep, gamified learning, select labs, and workshops all include reserved seating. Attendees do not need to reserve a seat for keynotes or lecture style-breakout sessions. If a session or activity is not included in reserved seating, it will be noted with "No reserved seating available." ### When does reserved seating open? Reserved seating is now open. Sign in to your attendee portal or the AWS Events app, navigate to the event catalog, and reserve your seats for the sessions you don't want to miss. Reserved seats are non-transferrable. ### If I reserve a seat, is my spot guaranteed? No. You must arrive at the room at least ten minutes prior to the session start time or your seat will be released to walk-up attendees and you will be asked to join the back of the walk-up line. ### What happens if I can't reserve a seat in the session I want to attend? Look for repeated instances of sessions (indicated with -R in the session ID) or continue checking back for availability in that session. You may also join the walk-up queue onsite. ### What is the difference between favoriting a session and reserving a seat? Favoriting a catalog entry adds sessions and activities you're interested in to your favorites list. You can favorite multiple sessions or activities that occur at the same time as you plan out your schedule for re:Invent. For session types that are included in reserved seating, you must take the additional step of reserving that session to secure your seat. You may not reserve seats in multiple sessions that occur at the same time. ### I favorited a session. Does that mean I have reserved a seat? No. Favoriting a session helps you better plan your time at re:Invent, but it does not reserve a seat. For session types that are included in reserved seating, you must take the additional step of reserving that session to secure your seat.

[\"Transit buffer between re:Invent camp.text: This was a chance for all of the grantees to connect with each other and the alumni advisors, play games, have a couple of drinks, eat some food, and overall break the ice before heading into the first day of re:Invent. ### Day 1: Sessions, House of Kiro, and the Expo Hall My first session was scheduled for 8am at MGM Grand. Before heading to re:Invent, I was aware it's large scale across the strip and had many people sharing tips about leaving enough time to get to your next session. Good time management and discipline are definitely needed to ensure you attend all of the sessions you want to see throughout the week, but it is also important to take the conference at a pace that suits you. The expo hall opened at 4pm. The conversations, swag, and networking that can happen with companies in this hall is an experience I had only ever read or heard about. ### ABW-specific programming I experienced ABW grantees got priority access to all of the keynotes. They fill up fast, so it is great to know that as long as you show up within the time window you need to be there for — you will have a seat reserved if you are a part of the grant. I started one day with the speed mentoring and networking session that was created specifically for participants of the ABW Grant. Before another session, I hung out in the ABW Lounge to get some professional headshots. As a 2025 recipient of the grant, I received 100% off one certification of my choice and as a ticket holder for re:Invent, I have another 50% off discount that I can also use. On the final evening there was a closing reception in the Wynn for the All Builders Welcome Grant before re:Play, the official closing party for the main conference week. ### Takeaways from a first-time grantee - re:Invent is HUGE and sees around 60,000 attendees from all around the world and spans across 6 hotels on the Las Vegas strip — your step count will be insane. - Your network will grow rapidly. I met so many people through the ABW program, during sessions, and even just when travelling between venues. - You will learn a lot about yourself in an environment with many like-minded people who are willing to give advice over a session or a coffee. - Pace yourself. The tiredness hit me the most on Day 3 and it is very important to take breaks.
[\"Transit buffer between re:Invent camp.title: Alumni experience: first time at re:Invent with the ABW grant (2025)

Yes. You will be able to access exclusive discounted rates at our select hotels after completing registration through your attendee portal. Sleeping room blocks close November 5, 2026. ### Will a deposit be charged to my credit card for the hotel reservation? Yes. You are required to provide a credit card when making a hotel reservation. A one-night deposit will be charged to your card directly by the hotel prior to the event. ### When will I receive a confirmation of my hotel reservation? After registering, you will receive a registration confirmation email followed by a separate email with your hotel acknowledgement number. Note that this is an acknowledgement, not a final hotel confirmation. You can verify your hotel booking at any time in your attendee portal. Official hotel confirmation emails will be sent directly by the hotel between November 5-13. Be sure to check your junk/spam folder if you haven't received one by then. ### How do I make changes to my reservation? You can make changes to your hotel reservation through your attendee portal by selecting Book or manage hotel until early November. To request availability at other hotels after you've made a reservation, email customer support at awsreinvent-support@amazon.com. ### What is the cancellation policy for the hotel reservation? All reservations made through the re:Invent block follow each hotel's cancellation policies. Please contact the hotel directly to inquire about their cancellation policy. ### I am under 21. Full conference passes include access to keynotes, breakout sessions, hands-on labs, and the broader event experience, including re:Play: the official re:Invent party. An add-on pass is available for re:Play-only entry. Full conference: - Full price: $2,499 - Bulk purchase price: Save 10% when purchasing 10 or more passes in a single transaction. Terms and conditions apply. - re:Play guest pass: $350 ### Is there an age requirement to attend re:Invent? Yes. All attendees must be at least 18 years of age by the day they pick up their conference badge. ### How do I purchase bulk discount tickets? During registration, you'll see the option to purchase group passes. If you plan to attend the event, you'll be able to apply a pass to yourself after you complete the purchase. Once you add 10 or more tickets to your cart, the 10% discount will automatically be applied. No discount code is needed. Upon completing the purchase, your group codes will be available in the attendee portal under the pass management tab. Provide the registration code to each person attending, and they will apply the code when registering to remove the cost of the conference pass. Each person must register themselves through their own account. ### How can I purchase a re:Play guest pass? During registration, select the re:Play guest pass, or choose the option to purchase additional passes from your attendee portal after you've completed registration. The purchase will generate a registration code that you will provide to your guest, which they will use to register themselves. Your guest will need to have a badge in order to attend re:Play. If you are already registered, you will not need to purchase a re:Play pass for yourself; entry is included in your general event registration. ### Do I need to be registered to attend the conference? Yes. You need to be registered for re:Invent in order to attend any event sessions or functions. A valid conference badge and lanyard are required when in the designated event spaces. ### Are there day passes or Expo-only passes available? No.

Sessions at re:Invent cover every format and depth: workshops and labs where you build alongside AWS engineers in groups as small as 10 people, chalk talks where architects diagram solutions in real time, code talks with live demos, lightning talks, bootcamps, breakout sessions, and keynotes. 70% of session formats are interactive and practitioner-led. ### What happened to re:Inforce? More content will be added leading up to the conference. ### Will bootcamps be offered at re:Invent? Bootcamps will be included in reserved seating for in-person attendees at no additional cost. ### In what venues will content be available? Content will be delivered across multiple venues including Caesars Forum, Caesars Palace, MGM Grand, The Venetian, and Wynn. ### Can I attend sessions at multiple venues? Yes. Please note the venue where your session will take place and allow for additional travel time between venues. ### Will content be available on demand? Yes. The keynotes and breakout sessions will be available on demand through the website after they are presented at re:Invent. ## Reserved Seating ### Will there be reserved seating? Yes. Reserved seating will open October 6. Registered attendees can start favoriting sessions in the event catalog. ### What is reserved seating? Reserved seating allows in-person attendees to secure a seat in a session in advance. Once reserved seating is open, attendees registered for in-person re:Invent can reserve seats in participating session types through the catalog by signing in to their attendee portal or by signing in to the AWS Events mobile app. ### What content types are included in reserved seating?

[\"Transit buffer between re:Invent camp.text: # Accessibility services at re:Invent 2026 - Source: https://aws.amazon.com/events/reinvent/plan/accessibility-services/ - Section: Accessibility at re:Invent - Event year: 2026 - Source type: official - Retrieved: 2026-11-04 ## Accessibility at re:Invent re:Invent is built to work for everyone. Here's what's available, what you can request, and how to get support before and during the event. ### Services available to all attendees #### Accessible seating Accessible seating is available in keynotes and session venues for attendees who are blind or low vision, deaf or hard-of-hearing, or who use mobility devices. Accessibility icons in and near the venue will guide you to these seats. For workshops, code talks, and sessions, an ambassador will be available in the room to assist with seating. #### All-gender restrooms All-gender restrooms will be available throughout the event. #### Assistive listening devices Assistive listening devices will be available for all keynotes, breakout sessions, lightning talks, and chalk talks. #### Lactation room A private, secure space will be provided for lactating attendees to express milk. A fridge will be available in the space. #### Live captioning All keynotes, breakout sessions, and lightning talks will feature live captioning for session content. For other sessions, iPads are available to display AI-powered live captions at your seat. The iPads will be provided on a first-come, first-served basis. #### Reflection room A quiet space that attendees can use for meditation, prayer, yoga, or finding resources for sensory needs will be available on campus. #### Sensory notice Some areas of re:Invent, especially the Expo and keynotes, include loud noise, moving lights, and atmospheric fog. Earplugs, fidget tools, noise-cancelling headphones, strobe-reducing glasses, and visual cue and feeling thermometer cards are available at the reflection room. #### Translations for keynotes Live translations in Japanese, Korean, Mandarin, and Spanish are available for keynotes. Headsets are provided at each venue. Additional languages are available via livestream. ### Services available by request #### How to request a service The following services are only available by advance request. Contact customer support (awsreinvent-support@amazon.com) to coordinate. The deadline for all requests is Nov. 13, 2026.

The conversations, swag, and networking that can happen with companies in this hall is an experience I had only ever read or heard about. ### ABW-specific programming I experienced ABW grantees got priority access to all of the keynotes. They fill up fast, so it is great to know that as long as you show up within the time window you need to be there for — you will have a seat reserved if you are a part of the grant. I started one day with the speed mentoring and networking session that was created specifically for participants of the ABW Grant. Before another session, I hung out in the ABW Lounge to get some professional headshots. As a 2025 recipient of the grant, I received 100% off one certification of my choice and as a ticket holder for re:Invent, I have another 50% off discount that I can also use. On the final evening there was a closing reception in the Wynn for the All Builders Welcome Grant before re:Play, the official closing party for the main conference week. ### Takeaways from a first-time grantee - re:Invent is HUGE and sees around 60,000 attendees from all around the world and spans across 6 hotels on the Las Vegas strip — your step count will be insane. - Your network will grow rapidly. I met so many people through the ABW program, during sessions, and even just when travelling between venues. - You will learn a lot about yourself in an environment with many like-minded people who are willing to give advice over a session or a coffee. - Pace yourself. The tiredness hit me the most on Day 3 and it is very important to take breaks.

So keep an eye out next June or July for it to open back up again. ### The dilemma: Network or attend breakout sessions and workshops? Coming to re:Invent, I faced a common dilemma among attendees: the choice between networking or immersing myself in the wealth of educational sessions and workshops that were available. Travel time between venues and sessions could take anywhere from 20 minutes to an hour. ### The FOMO factor AWS re:Invent is more than just a conference; it's a thriving community where connections are made, collaborations are built, and friendships flourish. A lot of attendees, including many of my fellow ABW grant winners, spent quite a bit more time than I did networking and building community. I don't regret choosing sessions, but I'll admit it's a bittersweet feeling.

We were shuttled to Area 15, an indoor, futuristic fun zone, where we were greeted with food, music, games, and free entry into several of the Area 15 attractions. It was a fun and low-pressure way for all of us grant winners to break the ice and shake off our nerves. During the rest of re:Invent, there was a dedicated lounge for ABW grant winners. This was a quiet place where we were welcome to go to take a break from the hustle and bustle, meet with our mentors, eat delicious snacks, and share our ongoing experiences with the other grant winners. And as an added bonus, AWS offered all grant recipients the opportunity to get free professional headshots taken. On Thursday evening, AWS threw the ABW grantees a lovely closing reception.

[\"What are the ABW eligibility requirem.text: # re:Invent 2026 FAQs — Builder ID - Source: https://aws.amazon.com/events/reinvent/faqs/ - Section: Using AWS Builder ID to register - Event year: 2026 - Source type: official - Retrieved: 2026-11-04 ## Using AWS Builder ID to register ### What is AWS Builder ID and AWS Profile? AWS Builder ID is a simple, personal identity for users, providing access to select AWS tools and services. This year, you'll be able to create or use an existing Builder ID to register for AWS re:Invent 2026. With AWS Builder ID, you can create an AWS Profile: a central place to manage your personal information and preferences. Your AWS Profile information is applied consistently across supported AWS experiences. ### Is Builder ID authentication required to register for AWS re:Invent? Yes. AWS Builder ID is required to register for re:Invent. The Builder ID serves as the authentication method for your re:Invent account. ### How do I register for re:Invent using Builder ID? Enter your email (business email preferred) or select one of the other authentication methods. If this is your first time setting up a Builder ID, you'll be prompted to create a password that you'll use to log into your re:Invent account, as well as your AWS Builder ID account. If you already have a Builder ID account, enter the credentials you normally use or select reset password. ### Who can I contact with additional questions? Please email awsreinvent-support@amazon.com for support. ### What if I already have an AWS Builder ID account? If you already have an AWS Builder ID profile, you can use those same credentials to log into your re:Invent account. ### Can I delete my Builder ID account after the event? If you no longer want to have your AWS Builder ID account, you can delete it post-event by following the instructions found in the Builder ID overview. Please note that if you delete your Builder ID account, you will also lose access to your current re:Invent account.

[\"What are the ABW eligibility requirem.text: # Accessibility services at re:Invent 2026 - Source: https://aws.amazon.com/events/reinvent/plan/accessibility-services/ - Section: Accessibility at re:Invent - Event year: 2026 - Source type: official - Retrieved: 2026-11-04 ## Accessibility at re:Invent re:Invent is built to work for everyone. Here's what's available, what you can request, and how to get support before and during the event. ### Services available to all attendees #### Accessible seating Accessible seating is available in keynotes and session venues for attendees who are blind or low vision, deaf or hard-of-hearing, or who use mobility devices. Accessibility icons in and near the venue will guide you to these seats. For workshops, code talks, and sessions, an ambassador will be available in the room to assist with seating. #### All-gender restrooms All-gender restrooms will be available throughout the event. #### Assistive listening devices Assistive listening devices will be available for all keynotes, breakout sessions, lightning talks, and chalk talks. #### Lactation room A private, secure space will be provided for lactating attendees to express milk. A fridge will be available in the space. #### Live captioning All keynotes, breakout sessions, and lightning talks will feature live captioning for session content. For other sessions, iPads are available to display AI-powered live captions at your seat. The iPads will be provided on a first-come, first-served basis. #### Reflection room A quiet space that attendees can use for meditation, prayer, yoga, or finding resources for sensory needs will be available on campus. #### Sensory notice Some areas of re:Invent, especially the Expo and keynotes, include loud noise, moving lights, and atmospheric fog. Earplugs, fidget tools, noise-cancelling headphones, strobe-reducing glasses, and visual cue and feeling thermometer cards are available at the reflection room. #### Translations for keynotes Live translations in Japanese, Korean, Mandarin, and Spanish are available for keynotes. Headsets are provided at each venue. Additional languages are available via livestream. ### Services available by request #### How to request a service The following services are only available by advance request. Contact customer support (awsreinvent-support@amazon.com) to coordinate. The deadline for all requests is Nov. 13, 2026.

[\"What are the ABW eligibility requirem.text: # re:Invent 2026 FAQs — AWS Certification - Source: https://aws.amazon.com/events/reinvent/faqs/ - Section: AWS Certification - Event year: 2026 - Source type: official - Retrieved: 2026-11-04 ## AWS Certification ### Will certification exams be offered at re:Invent? Certification exams will not be offered onsite at re:Invent; however, all in-person re:Invent registrants will receive a 50% discount for any AWS Certification exam. You can access your voucher and see additional details in your attendee portal. ### Who is eligible for the 50% discount voucher toward an AWS Certification exam? Anyone who registers to attend AWS re:Invent in person is eligible to receive a 50% discount voucher that can be applied towards an AWS Certification exam of your choice. Terms and conditions apply. ### If I registered to attend AWS re:Invent virtually, am I eligible for the discount exam voucher? No, only those who register to attend re:Invent in person are eligible to receive a 50% discount exam voucher. ### How and when will I receive the 50% discount exam voucher? After you register to attend re:Invent in person, you can access your voucher code in your re:Invent Attendee Portal. ### How do I use the 50% discount exam voucher? Your exam appointment can be for any day before January 31, 2027. Offer limited to one exam voucher per individual. Offer cannot be combined with any other offers. ### When does my 50% discount exam voucher expire? January 31, 2027, 11:59 PM (PDT). ### How can I get verified onsite to get into certification-exclusive areas? Visit the Verify my AWS Certification desk at the Venetian on Sunday and Monday or the AWS Certification Lounge at Caesars Forum from Sunday to Friday. You can also pre-verify online directly in your re:Invent Attendee Portal.
[\"What are the ABW eligibility requirem.title: re:Invent 2026 FAQs — AWS Certification

We want re:Invent to be accessible for everyone. The following services will be available at the conference for all attendees with no advance request required: - Assistive listening - Translations for keynotes (Japanese, Korean, Mandarin, and LATAM Spanish) - English captions for all content spaces - Dispersed and designated seating - Lactation rooms - Reflection rooms - All-gender restrooms These additional services can be requested in advance: - ASL (American Sign Language) interpretation - Sighted guide - Mobility device rental - Kosher meals - Halal meals - Accessible transportation To request any of these services or inquire about a service you don't see listed, including neurodivergent and sensory need requests, contact customer support at awsreinvent-support@amazon.com. To properly coordinate services, all requests must be received by November 14th. Requests for services received after this date cannot be guaranteed. Please visit our accessibility services page for more information. ### Are you offering accessible transportation? Yes. Accessible transportation will be available during transportation hours. Attendees can make arrangements at least one hour prior to their pickup. The phone number will be available prior to the event. Please visit our accessibility services page for more information.

The ABW Grant covers the cost of in-person attendance to re:Invent 2026 for those just beginning their journey into tech or are within the first five years of their career. This year, a limited number of grants will also be awarded to select university students preparing for a role in tech. Throughout re:Invent, grant participants will have access to the full agenda alongside a specially curated program featuring a welcome event, peer meetup, and mentorship with AWS experts. Participants leave with lasting relationships and a network they can rely on throughout their careers. Applications are now closed. For full eligibility details, please review the Terms and Conditions.
[\"What are the ABW grant benefits?\", 2.title: All Builders Welcome Grant (re:Invent 2026)

On Thursday evening, AWS threw the ABW grantees a lovely closing reception. After drinks and some fancy hors d'oeuvres, we all packed together for hilarious group photos. ### How to apply for the AWS All Builders Welcome Grant (historical, 2023) For anyone interested in applying for the ABW grant, the qualifications described at the time of this post were: - Be an underrepresented technologist in the first five years of your career - Have a strong interest in cloud computing - Be able to commit to attending all four days of re:Invent - Be at least 21 years old - Have not previously accepted a grant to an AWS event - Not be an employee, intern, independent contractor, officer, director, legal or financial advisor of AWS or any of its parents, subsidiaries, affiliates, advisors, or advertising/promotion agencies The application for the grant opens up in the summer and will be shared on the AWS re:Invent site when it opens. So keep an eye out next June or July for it to open back up again. ### The dilemma: Network or attend breakout sessions and workshops? Coming to re:Invent, I faced a common dilemma among attendees: the choice between networking or immersing myself in the wealth of educational sessions and workshops that were available. Travel time between venues and sessions could take anywhere from 20 minutes to an hour. ### The FOMO factor AWS re:Invent is more than just a conference; it's a thriving community where connections are made, collaborations are built, and friendships flourish. A lot of attendees, including many of my fellow ABW grant winners, spent quite a bit more time than I did networking and building community. I don't regret choosing sessions, but I'll admit it's a bittersweet feeling.

This is the story of my adventure as a recipient of an All Builders Welcome Grant from AWS, and my first-ever AWS re:Invent. ### Navigating re:Invent as an All Builders Welcome Grant winner I found myself in this fortunate position when I won an All Builders Welcome (ABW) Grant from AWS. This grant, which provides a complimentary trip to re:Invent, acknowledged my individual accomplishments and is also part of a bigger AWS initiative to bridge the gap in tech for people from underrepresented communities. ### My daily experience We kicked off the week on Sunday evening with a fun welcome reception. We were shuttled to Area 15, an indoor, futuristic fun zone, where we were greeted with food, music, games, and free entry into several of the Area 15 attractions. It was a fun and low-pressure way for all of us grant winners to break the ice and shake off our nerves. During the rest of re:Invent, there was a dedicated lounge for ABW grant winners. This was a quiet place where we were welcome to go to take a break from the hustle and bustle, meet with our mentors, eat delicious snacks, and share our ongoing experiences with the other grant winners. And as an added bonus, AWS offered all grant recipients the opportunity to get free professional headshots taken. On Thursday evening, AWS threw the ABW grantees a lovely closing reception.

[\"What are the ABW grant benefits?\", 2.text: # re:Invent 2026 FAQs — AWS Certification - Source: https://aws.amazon.com/events/reinvent/faqs/ - Section: AWS Certification - Event year: 2026 - Source type: official - Retrieved: 2026-11-04 ## AWS Certification ### Will certification exams be offered at re:Invent? Certification exams will not be offered onsite at re:Invent; however, all in-person re:Invent registrants will receive a 50% discount for any AWS Certification exam. You can access your voucher and see additional details in your attendee portal. ### Who is eligible for the 50% discount voucher toward an AWS Certification exam? Anyone who registers to attend AWS re:Invent in person is eligible to receive a 50% discount voucher that can be applied towards an AWS Certification exam of your choice. Terms and conditions apply. ### If I registered to attend AWS re:Invent virtually, am I eligible for the discount exam voucher? No, only those who register to attend re:Invent in person are eligible to receive a 50% discount exam voucher. ### How and when will I receive the 50% discount exam voucher? After you register to attend re:Invent in person, you can access your voucher code in your re:Invent Attendee Portal. ### How do I use the 50% discount exam voucher? Your exam appointment can be for any day before January 31, 2027. Offer limited to one exam voucher per individual. Offer cannot be combined with any other offers. ### When does my 50% discount exam voucher expire? January 31, 2027, 11:59 PM (PDT). ### How can I get verified onsite to get into certification-exclusive areas? Visit the Verify my AWS Certification desk at the Venetian on Sunday and Monday or the AWS Certification Lounge at Caesars Forum from Sunday to Friday. You can also pre-verify online directly in your re:Invent Attendee Portal.

[\"What are the ABW grant benefits?\", 2.text: # re:Invent 2026 FAQs — Builder ID - Source: https://aws.amazon.com/events/reinvent/faqs/ - Section: Using AWS Builder ID to register - Event year: 2026 - Source type: official - Retrieved: 2026-11-04 ## Using AWS Builder ID to register ### What is AWS Builder ID and AWS Profile? AWS Builder ID is a simple, personal identity for users, providing access to select AWS tools and services. This year, you'll be able to create or use an existing Builder ID to register for AWS re:Invent 2026. With AWS Builder ID, you can create an AWS Profile: a central place to manage your personal information and preferences. Your AWS Profile information is applied consistently across supported AWS experiences. ### Is Builder ID authentication required to register for AWS re:Invent? Yes. AWS Builder ID is required to register for re:Invent. The Builder ID serves as the authentication method for your re:Invent account. ### How do I register for re:Invent using Builder ID? Enter your email (business email preferred) or select one of the other authentication methods. If this is your first time setting up a Builder ID, you'll be prompted to create a password that you'll use to log into your re:Invent account, as well as your AWS Builder ID account. If you already have a Builder ID account, enter the credentials you normally use or select reset password. ### Who can I contact with additional questions? Please email awsreinvent-support@amazon.com for support. ### What if I already have an AWS Builder ID account? If you already have an AWS Builder ID profile, you can use those same credentials to log into your re:Invent account. ### Can I delete my Builder ID account after the event? If you no longer want to have your AWS Builder ID account, you can delete it post-event by following the instructions found in the Builder ID overview. Please note that if you delete your Builder ID account, you will also lose access to your current re:Invent account.

[\"What are the ABW grant benefits?\", 2.text: # re:Invent 2026 FAQs — Accessibility services - Source: https://aws.amazon.com/events/reinvent/faqs/ - Section: Accessibility Services - Event year: 2026 - Source type: official - Retrieved: 2026-11-04 ## Accessibility Services ### What accessibility services will be available at re:Invent? We want re:Invent to be accessible for everyone. The following services will be available at the conference for all attendees with no advance request required: - Assistive listening - Translations for keynotes (Japanese, Korean, Mandarin, and LATAM Spanish) - English captions for all content spaces - Dispersed and designated seating - Lactation rooms - Reflection rooms - All-gender restrooms These additional services can be requested in advance: - ASL (American Sign Language) interpretation - Sighted guide - Mobility device rental - Kosher meals - Halal meals - Accessible transportation To request any of these services or inquire about a service you don't see listed, including neurodivergent and sensory need requests, contact customer support at awsreinvent-support@amazon.com. To properly coordinate services, all requests must be received by November 14th. Requests for services received after this date cannot be guaranteed. Please visit our accessibility services page for more information. ### Are you offering accessible transportation? Yes. Accessible transportation will be available during transportation hours. Attendees can make arrangements at least one hour prior to their pickup. The phone number will be available prior to the event. Please visit our accessibility services page for more information.
[\"What are the ABW grant benefits?\", 2.title: re:Invent 2026 FAQs — Accessibility services
