Include this in your request by November 13, 2026. #### Accessible transportation Accessible transportation across the re:Invent campus will be available throughout the week, including for re:Play, the official AWS re:Invent party. This service does not include transportation to or from the airport. Contact the accessible transportation concierge at least one hour prior to requested pickup. Wait times may vary. Requests will be accepted starting on Sunday, Nov. 29. The concierge phone number will be available at a later date. #### American Sign Language (ASL) interpretation ASL interpretation is available for sessions, keynotes, and events. #### Dietary needs Halal and Kosher meals are available. Gluten-free, vegan, vegetarian, and common allergy accommodations are included as part of the standard buffet. #### Mobility devices Pickup details will be shared closer to the event. If you didn't request one in advance, visit the help desk on-site. All devices must be returned to the hotel bell desk at checkout. #### Sighted guide A sighted guide service is available by request for attendees who are blind or low vision. ### More information #### Service animals Service animals are welcome at all re:Invent venues. Designated relief areas will be available. Contact your hotel directly to confirm their service animal policy. #### Support during re:Invent An accessibility concierge will be available by phone or text during event hours to assist with accessibility questions or needs. The phone number will be made available closer to the event. You can also email customer support (awsreinvent-support@amazon.com) or visit a help desk on-site.

[\"What extra programming do grant recip.text: # Alumni experience: first time at re:Invent with the ABW grant (2025) - Source: https://builder.aws.com/content/36ZF1aPahQtQqlcnk0gaNw7jQzY/my-first-time-experiencing-aws-reinvent-thanks-to-the-abw-grant - Section: Personal experience - Event year: 2025 - Source type: alumni_experience - Retrieved: 2026-11-04 ## My first time experiencing AWS re:Invent, thanks to the ABW grant! This is personal experience from an All Builders Welcome Grant recipient at re:Invent 2025. It is not official AWS guidance. re:Invent 2025 was an incredible experience and could not have been possible without the AWS All Builders Welcome Grant. I was selected alongside many others globally to attend the event all expenses paid. If you are in the first 5 years of your career and meet the requirements for the application criteria — I urge you to apply for the grant in 2026 when they open next year. The opportunity to attend through the grant is once in a lifetime. ### Day 0: Arriving to Las Vegas and the ABW Grant Welcome Reception After 16 hours of travelling from Belfast, I arrived at Harry Reid airport in Las Vegas around 5pm on the 30th November, the day before re:Invent officially kicked off. AWS staff checked us in to collect our badges, which was used as a pass into re:Invent hosting hotels, sessions, and even some exclusive parties that happened in the evenings throughout the week. We got a Lyft over to Treasure Island, checked in, then headed over to the Welcome Reception for the ABW Grant via shuttle bus, which was a 7pm start at a venue within Area15. This was a chance for all of the grantees to connect with each other and the alumni advisors, play games, have a couple of drinks, eat some food, and overall break the ice before heading into the first day of re:Invent. ### Day 1: Sessions, House of Kiro, and the Expo Hall My first session was scheduled for 8am at MGM Grand. Before heading to re:Invent, I was aware it's large scale across the strip and had many people sharing tips about leaving enough time to get to your next session.

[\"What extra programming do grant recip.text: This was a chance for all of the grantees to connect with each other and the alumni advisors, play games, have a couple of drinks, eat some food, and overall break the ice before heading into the first day of re:Invent. ### Day 1: Sessions, House of Kiro, and the Expo Hall My first session was scheduled for 8am at MGM Grand. Before heading to re:Invent, I was aware it's large scale across the strip and had many people sharing tips about leaving enough time to get to your next session. Good time management and discipline are definitely needed to ensure you attend all of the sessions you want to see throughout the week, but it is also important to take the conference at a pace that suits you. The expo hall opened at 4pm. The conversations, swag, and networking that can happen with companies in this hall is an experience I had only ever read or heard about. ### ABW-specific programming I experienced ABW grantees got priority access to all of the keynotes. They fill up fast, so it is great to know that as long as you show up within the time window you need to be there for — you will have a seat reserved if you are a part of the grant. I started one day with the speed mentoring and networking session that was created specifically for participants of the ABW Grant. Before another session, I hung out in the ABW Lounge to get some professional headshots. As a 2025 recipient of the grant, I received 100% off one certification of my choice and as a ticket holder for re:Invent, I have another 50% off discount that I can also use. On the final evening there was a closing reception in the Wynn for the All Builders Welcome Grant before re:Play, the official closing party for the main conference week. ### Takeaways from a first-time grantee - re:Invent is HUGE and sees around 60,000 attendees from all around the world and spans across 6 hotels on the Las Vegas strip — your step count will be insane. - Your network will grow rapidly. I met so many people through the ABW program, during sessions, and even just when travelling between venues. - You will learn a lot about yourself in an environment with many like-minded people who are willing to give advice over a session or a coffee. - Pace yourself. The tiredness hit me the most on Day 3 and it is very important to take breaks.

[\"What extra programming do grant recip.text: # Alumni experience: a newcomer's first re:Invent (2023) - Source: https://www.pluralsight.com/resources/blog/cloud/newcomers-guide-to-aws-reinvent - Section: Personal experience - Event year: 2023 - Source type: alumni_experience - Retrieved: 2026-11-04 ## All Builders Welcome: A newcomer's first AWS re:Invent This is personal experience from an All Builders Welcome Grant recipient, published December 13, 2023. It is not official AWS guidance. Eligibility rules, dates, and benefits for later years are governed by the current official Terms and Conditions. This is the story of my adventure as a recipient of an All Builders Welcome Grant from AWS, and my first-ever AWS re:Invent. ### Navigating re:Invent as an All Builders Welcome Grant winner I found myself in this fortunate position when I won an All Builders Welcome (ABW) Grant from AWS. This grant, which provides a complimentary trip to re:Invent, acknowledged my individual accomplishments and is also part of a bigger AWS initiative to bridge the gap in tech for people from underrepresented communities. ### My daily experience We kicked off the week on Sunday evening with a fun welcome reception. We were shuttled to Area 15, an indoor, futuristic fun zone, where we were greeted with food, music, games, and free entry into several of the Area 15 attractions. It was a fun and low-pressure way for all of us grant winners to break the ice and shake off our nerves. During the rest of re:Invent, there was a dedicated lounge for ABW grant winners. This was a quiet place where we were welcome to go to take a break from the hustle and bustle, meet with our mentors, eat delicious snacks, and share our ongoing experiences with the other grant winners. And as an added bonus, AWS offered all grant recipients the opportunity to get free professional headshots taken. On Thursday evening, AWS threw the ABW grantees a lovely closing reception.

[\"What happens if I cannot attend the f.text: Registered attendees can start favoriting sessions in the event catalog. ### What is reserved seating? Reserved seating allows in-person attendees to secure a seat in a session in advance. Once reserved seating is open, attendees registered for in-person re:Invent can reserve seats in participating session types through the catalog by signing in to their attendee portal or by signing in to the AWS Events mobile app. ### What content types are included in reserved seating? Bootcamps, technical sessions, chalk talks, code talks, exam prep, gamified learning, select labs, and workshops all include reserved seating. Attendees do not need to reserve a seat for keynotes or lecture style-breakout sessions. If a session or activity is not included in reserved seating, it will be noted with "No reserved seating available." ### When does reserved seating open? Reserved seating is now open. Sign in to your attendee portal or the AWS Events app, navigate to the event catalog, and reserve your seats for the sessions you don't want to miss. Reserved seats are non-transferrable. ### If I reserve a seat, is my spot guaranteed? No. You must arrive at the room at least ten minutes prior to the session start time or your seat will be released to walk-up attendees and you will be asked to join the back of the walk-up line. ### What happens if I can't reserve a seat in the session I want to attend? Look for repeated instances of sessions (indicated with -R in the session ID) or continue checking back for availability in that session. You may also join the walk-up queue onsite. ### What is the difference between favoriting a session and reserving a seat? Favoriting a catalog entry adds sessions and activities you're interested in to your favorites list. You can favorite multiple sessions or activities that occur at the same time as you plan out your schedule for re:Invent. For session types that are included in reserved seating, you must take the additional step of reserving that session to secure your seat. You may not reserve seats in multiple sessions that occur at the same time. ### I favorited a session. Does that mean I have reserved a seat? No. Favoriting a session helps you better plan your time at re:Invent, but it does not reserve a seat. For session types that are included in reserved seating, you must take the additional step of reserving that session to secure your seat.

[\"What happens if I cannot attend the f.text: # re:Invent 2026 FAQs — Hotels & accommodations - Source: https://aws.amazon.com/events/reinvent/faqs/ - Section: Hotels & Accommodations - Event year: 2026 - Source type: official - Retrieved: 2026-11-04 ## Hotels & Accommodations ### Are there discounted hotel rates for attendees? Yes. You will be able to access exclusive discounted rates at our select hotels after completing registration through your attendee portal. The discount will be automatically reflected in the rates; no code is needed. Discounted rates are available as inventory allows through November 5, 2026. ### How do I book a hotel for re:Invent? After completing registration, select Book or manage hotel, or log back in to your attendee portal to make a reservation. Hotels fill quickly, so we recommend making your reservation early. Sleeping room blocks close November 5, 2026. ### Will a deposit be charged to my credit card for the hotel reservation? Yes. You are required to provide a credit card when making a hotel reservation. A one-night deposit will be charged to your card directly by the hotel prior to the event. ### When will I receive a confirmation of my hotel reservation? After registering, you will receive a registration confirmation email followed by a separate email with your hotel acknowledgement number. Note that this is an acknowledgement, not a final hotel confirmation. You can verify your hotel booking at any time in your attendee portal. Official hotel confirmation emails will be sent directly by the hotel between November 5-13. Be sure to check your junk/spam folder if you haven't received one by then. ### How do I make changes to my reservation? You can make changes to your hotel reservation through your attendee portal by selecting Book or manage hotel until early November. To request availability at other hotels after you've made a reservation, email customer support at awsreinvent-support@amazon.com. ### What is the cancellation policy for the hotel reservation? All reservations made through the re:Invent block follow each hotel's cancellation policies. Please contact the hotel directly to inquire about their cancellation policy. ### I am under 21. Can I still stay at a re:Invent campus hotel? Due to gaming regulations, you must be at least 21 years old to make a reservation at all re:Invent campus hotels, excluding Treasure Island.

[\"What happens if I cannot attend the f.text: # re:Invent 2026 FAQs — Registration & passes - Source: https://aws.amazon.com/events/reinvent/faqs/ - Section: Registration & Passes - Event year: 2026 - Source type: official - Retrieved: 2026-11-04 ## Registration & Passes ### How much does it cost to attend re:Invent? Full conference passes include access to keynotes, breakout sessions, hands-on labs, and the broader event experience, including re:Play: the official re:Invent party. An add-on pass is available for re:Play-only entry. Full conference: - Full price: $2,499 - Bulk purchase price: Save 10% when purchasing 10 or more passes in a single transaction. Terms and conditions apply. - re:Play guest pass: $350 ### Is there an age requirement to attend re:Invent? Yes. All attendees must be at least 18 years of age by the day they pick up their conference badge. ### How do I purchase bulk discount tickets? During registration, you'll see the option to purchase group passes. If you plan to attend the event, you'll be able to apply a pass to yourself after you complete the purchase. Once you add 10 or more tickets to your cart, the 10% discount will automatically be applied. No discount code is needed. Upon completing the purchase, your group codes will be available in the attendee portal under the pass management tab. Provide the registration code to each person attending, and they will apply the code when registering to remove the cost of the conference pass. Each person must register themselves through their own account. ### How can I purchase a re:Play guest pass? During registration, select the re:Play guest pass, or choose the option to purchase additional passes from your attendee portal after you've completed registration. The purchase will generate a registration code that you will provide to your guest, which they will use to register themselves. Your guest will need to have a badge in order to attend re:Play. If you are already registered, you will not need to purchase a re:Play pass for yourself; entry is included in your general event registration. ### Do I need to be registered to attend the conference? Yes. You need to be registered for re:Invent in order to attend any event sessions or functions. A valid conference badge and lanyard are required when in the designated event spaces. ### Are there day passes or Expo-only passes available? No.
